quantity: Damped inverses of minibatch KFAC factors
method: For a factor lambda I + Y^T Y / M, invert M lambda I + YY^T when the minibatch size M is smaller than the layer dimension; use direct inversion otherwise.
caveat: The fully connected-layer inversion is exact for the chosen damped minibatch factors. The Fisher/Kronecker model and convolutional extensions introduce approximations. This is not an online eigenspace tracker for full EMA factors; the benefit depends on batch size versus width.
